:::{#def-canonical-link}
#### Canonical link function

Let $\Rvar$ have a [distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) in an [exponential family](#def-exponential-family)
with [natural parameter](#def-natural-parameter) $\natparam$,
[statistic](sufficiency.qmd#def-statistic) $\statf{\rvar} = \rvar$,
and log-partition function $\logpartition$.
By @thm-log-partition-mean,
the [mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of $\Rvar$ is
$\mean = \dif{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam}$.
The **canonical link function** is the function that takes the mean to the natural parameter,
the [inverse function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-inverse-function) of that [derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-derivative):

$$
\natparam = \inv{\paren{\dif{\logpartition}{\natparam}}}\paren{\mean}.
$$

:::
